description: Approve or decline a high-impact action the CMO or autowhisper_action asked you to confirm. Pass the message_id it gave you and decision "yes" or "no".

decision.description: "yes" to perform the action, "no" to decline.

message_id.description: The message_id from the confirmation request.

workspace_id.description: The workspace the confirmation lives in — pass the SAME one you used for autowhisper_cmo. Omitting it falls back to the account's first active workspace and 404s on a bubble that lives anywhere else.

name: autowhisper_confirm
title: Confirm an AutoWhisper action
